heading: Dependency and disability decisions
lead: The General Counsel of the Government Accountability Office shall decide a question of dependency, disability, or dependency and disability under sections 773–776 of this title. A decision under this section is final.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised SectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 77831:43b(h).June 10, 1921, ch. 18, 42 Stat. 20, § 319(h); added July 13, 1959, Pub. L. 86–87, 73 Stat. 198. The words “arising” and “and conclusive” are omitted as surplus.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2004—Pub. L. 108–271 substituted “Government Accountability Office” for “General Accounting Office”.
